csv_project_name: Inspection Services for Residential Housing Rehabilitation
csv_scope_of_work: Richland County (County) is seeking electronic proposals from qualified vendors to provide professional inspection services for predominantly residential properties; however, these services will be needed for public facilities undergoing rehabilitation work as part of federally funded programs run by the County s Community Development Office. The vendor may also be needed to provide or confirm estimations for rehabilitation work on additional single-family homes.
csv_disciplines_requested: Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Feasibility Studies, Inspection Services, Structural Engineering
csv_comments: '- Project Number: RC-799-QU-26- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 05/20/2026 02:00 PM EDT - Question Submit Online
title: Inspection Services for Residential Housing Rehabilitation
short_description: Inspection services for residential and public facility rehabilitation under county federally funded programs.
project_scope: Professional inspection services for predominantly residential properties undergoing rehabilitation, with additional services for public facilities under federally funded Community Development Office programs. The vendor may also provide or verify cost estimates for rehabilitation work on additional single-family homes. No building sizes, gross floor areas, or other technical structural characteristics are stated.
services: Inspection services for rehabilitation projects; possible preparation or confirmation of rehabilitation cost estimates; disciplines listed include surveying/GIS/mapping, feasibility studies, inspection services, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an inspection services contract for residential rehabilitation, not a structural design or complex engineering assignment.
- Focus is on single-family homes and public facility rehabilitation, which does not align well with sbp's core interest in bridges, long-span roofs, special structures, or complex buildings.
- Includes feasibility and inspection-related disciplines rather than substantial planning or structural design scope.
- No indication of architecturally demanding, innovative, lightweight, or large-span structures.
- Residential rehabilitation is outside sbp's preferred target profile.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the tender documents. The notice only mentions rehabilitation of predominantly residential properties and some public facilities under federally funded programs, without quantities, sizes, or program budgets. A realistic construction cost estimate is not possible from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. Because the scope is an on-call-style inspection and estimating service for unspecified rehabilitation projects, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the available information.
references_qualifications: Qualified vendors to provide professional inspection services for residential properties and public facilities undergoing rehabilitation. No specific minimum number or type of reference projects is stated in the provided notice.
contracting_authority: Richland County, Columbia, South Carolina, USA. Contact: Tamar Black. Phone: 803-929-6000. Fax: 803-576-2135. Email: black.tamar@richlandcountysc.gov. Website: https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/richlandcountysc/projects/261566
notes: Project number: RC-799-QU-26. Target market: General Building. Contract duration: base period 6 months, renewable, with 12-month renewal option. Questions deadline: 05/20/2026 02:00 PM EDT. Although structural engineering is listed among requested disciplines, the overall procurement is clearly centered on inspection services and rehabilitation support rather than design.
